title: Team Lead, ADM Operations
description:
**Who We Are**
 Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI\-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $9 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end\-to\-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo.
   

  

**The Role**
 Addepar has just launched an Alternatives Product offering that gives Addepar clients the option to have their Private Funds data extracted, processed, validated, and ingested directly from Private Fund documents for a more automated end\-to\-end solution for handling Alternatives on the platform. This white\-glove solution combines proprietary machine learning technology that automatically extracts data from Private Funds documents and human\-in\-loop review to validate any documents that fail to pass confidence and data quality checks.
   

  

 As part of the broader Addepar Data organization, the Alternatives Data Ops team is responsible for the human\-in\-loop review of Private Funds documents, ensuring clients' Alternatives data is processed, validated, and available in Addepar in a timely manner. This role will include managing a team and reviewing Private Fund statements, modifying data that has been incorrectly extracted by our machine learning models, and reprocessing the data within SLAs. The Alternatives Data Ops team plays a critical role in the success of Addepar's Alternatives offering and requires daily communications with the Alternatives Product Team, Machine Learning Operations, clients, data providers (GPs and Fund Admins), and additional personnel across the organization.
   

  

 Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead and manage a team of Analysts \& Senior Analysts ensuring effective work allocation, timely delivery.
* Act as a Subject matter expert \& support the team on complex document processing
* Guide and oversee the team in troubleshooting complex Private Fund statement processing exceptions
* Perform quality reviews and assist the team in modifying incorrectly extracted data
* Track and drive key team performance metrics, including SLA compliance, processing accuracy, and throughput.
* Act as a primary escalation point for operational and data quality issues.
* Partner with our Machine Learning Operations team to identify and relabel documents for model retraining
* Engage clients, GPs, or Fund Admins on statement data related inquiries
* Support the Maintenance Alternatives Data Operations workflow procedures and play\-books.
* Identify opportunities for automation, process optimization, and standardization.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to implement new processes and tooling features that improve Alternatives Data processing UX and increase operational workflow efficiency.


**Who You Are**
* Minimum 5\+ years of experience in a relevant role and domain
* Minimum 2\+ years of people Team leader experience
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, or a related field
* Experience in Private equity / Alternatives investment process
* Experience in the financial investment/advisory industry with strong knowledge of capital markets, middle/back\-office operations systems, and preferably with experience dealing with Alternatives (Private/Draw\-down) Funds reporting statements and data
* Track record of demonstrating excellent attention to detail, effective problem\-solving skills, and an ability to thrive in a fast paced environment
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills for engaging clients, data providers, and internal stakeholders across Sales, Services, and R\&D
* Highly self\-motivated to take on responsibility, forward thinking and pragmatic, and possess a collaborative team\-player mentality
* Technical skills preferred in any or all of the following: Microsoft Excel, Google Suite, Atlassian Jira/Confluence, SQL, Salesforce, or other common financial services systems and applications
* Willing to work in overlapping US/EMEA shifts or flexible hours to align with global stakeholders


**Our Values**
* Act Like an Owner \- Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together \- Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients \- Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation \- Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning \- Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.


 In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
   

  

 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
   

  

 PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta\-operations@addepar.com.

title: Sr. Lead, Alternatives Data Operations
description:
**Who We Are**
 Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI\-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $9 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end\-to\-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo.
   

  

**The Role**
 Addepar has just launched an Alternatives Product offering that gives Addepar clients the option to have their Private Funds data extracted, processed, validated, and ingested directly from Private Fund documents for a more automated end\-to\-end solution for handling Alternatives on the platform. This white\-glove solution combines proprietary machine learning technology that automatically extracts data from Private Funds documents and human\-in\-loop review to validate any documents that fail to pass confidence and data quality checks.
   

  

 As a Senior Lead of the Alternatives Data Operations, you will lead the operations function that is responsible for the human\-in\-loop review of Private Funds documents, ensuring clients' Alternatives data is processed, validated, and available in Addepar in a timely manner. You will manage a team of Alternatives Data Ops analysts who review Private Fund statements, modify data that has been incorrectly extracted by our machine learning models, and reprocess data within SLAs. In this role, you'll own the operational strategy, team performance, and continuous improvement of the Alternatives Data Ops function—a critical component of Addepar's Alternatives offering success.
   

  

 Your responsibilities will include building and scaling a high\-performing team, establishing processes and metrics that optimize quality and throughput, managing SLA performance, and serving as the primary liaison between the Alternatives Data Ops team and cross\-functional partners including the Alternatives Product Team, Engineering, Client Delivery, and additional personnel across the organization.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Develop and execute a strategic roadmap for Alternatives and Market data operations, aligning with Addepar's business objectives and corporate growth plans.
* Drive automation and efficiency initiatives, identifying opportunities to reduce manual work, streamline workflows, and scale the team's capacity
* Collaborate with senior leadership to understand the organization's evolving needs and ensure the data operations strategy is closely aligned with these goals.
* Own operational strategy and metrics, establishing KPIs around data quality, processing speed, and client satisfaction—identifying trends, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement
* Lead issue resolution and escalation, proactively managing blockers and maintaining alignment with internal stakeholders
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Client Solutions to implement new processes and tooling that improve the data processing experience and increase operational efficiency


**Operational Management**
* Oversee the spectrum of operational workflows for alternatives data and market data feeds, ensuring smooth execution and rapid issue resolution.
* Maintain effective process controls to ensure quality standards, and organizational objectives and deliverables are achieved. Establish, monitor, and report on Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for data delivery, ensuring consistent and timely provision of accurate data to internal and external stakeholders.
* Implement robust KPI tracking, metrics and analytics to measure operational effectiveness, resource utilization, operations scalability, and cost\-effectiveness
* Establish and maintain processes, workflows, and playbooks that ensure consistency, quality, and scalability across the Alternatives Data Ops function


**People Management and Culture**
* Lead and grow the Alternatives Data Ops team, including hiring, onboarding, mentoring, and fostering career development—helping team members understand the business impact of their work and creating opportunities for growth within the function
* Mentor managers/leads and consistently promote knowledge sharing and best practices to all groups.
* Manage a global team, fostering a strong culture alongside achieving results: Balance driving performance with cultivating a high\-performing, inclusive, and growth\-oriented team culture. Lead by example, empowering team members to innovate and collaborate effectively, while ensuring accountability for measurable outcomes
* Oversee recruitment, onboarding, and training of new team members.


**Who You Are**
* 10\+ years of experience in data operations, data management, or a related field within the financial services or wealth tech industry.
* Proven experience in a senior leadership role
* Extensive experience with Alternatives Data (e.g., Private Equity, Hedge Funds, Real Estate, Private Credit) is a must. Experience with Market Data (e.g., equities, fixed income, derivatives, pricing, corporate actions) is a nice to have.
* Proven experience using process automation, operational workflow re\-engineering and continuous improvement to enhance operational efficiency and scalability by using modern tools and technologies.
* Demonstrated track record of improving data quality and operational efficiency.
* Strong project management and analytical skills with experience in leading change management
* Experienced with leading global teams, cross\-functional and cross\-regional projects, and learning and development initiatives.
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills for engaging with clients, external data partners, and internal team members and stakeholders.


**Our Values**
* Act Like an Owner \- Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together \- Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients \- Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation \- Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning \- Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.


 In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
   

  

 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
   

  

 PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta\-operations@addepar.com.

**Job Purpose**
 The TM – Core Performance role requires strong knowledge of 4G LTE/EPC and 5G NSA/SA architecture, along with hands\-on experience in Packet Core KPI monitoring, analysis, and troubleshooting. The role also requires a good understanding of core network elements, DNS, interfaces, protocols, Cloud/NFV infrastructure, and Cloud KPIs such as CPU, memory, disk, VM/container health, and network utilization. Key responsibilities include identifying KPI degradation, performing PCAP analysis, conducting troubleshooting and RCA, and coordinating with internal teams and vendors to maintain network performance and service stability.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* PAN\-India Core Monitoring: Monitor performance across multi\-vendor core network nodes, including MME, SGW, PGW, and PCRF.
* Success Rate Tracking: Track key Packet Core success metrics, including S11 SR, ASR, PDN, LUSR, and WiFi\-to\-LTE handovers, and initiate timely corrective actions.
* Capacity and Throughput Management: Audit IP pool utilization and SGW/PGW throughput trends to support demand forecasting and capacity planning.
* Enterprise Platform Oversight: Monitor DRA/OCS performance and AAA/APN\-wise KPIs to support enterprise service efficiency and stability.
* P1 Incident Response: Support high\-priority incident resolution through real\-time KPI analysis, alerting, and coordination with cross\-functional teams.
* Reporting and Audits: Conduct parameter audits for quality compliance and publish weekly Data Core and Cloud KPI trend reports.
* Technology Evolution: Build knowledge across emerging technology areas, including WiFi, DNS, Cloud KPIs, and Packet Core 4G/5G architectures.
* Cloud Infrastructure Monitoring: Monitor infrastructure\-level Cloud KPIs such as CPU load, virtualization latency, VM/container health, and virtual switch packet drops for cloud\-native telecom functions.
* OpenSignal, Customer Complaints and User Experience Monitoring: Monitor OpenSignal KPIs, including download/upload speed, latency, packet loss, discard rate, and TTFB. Analyse customer complaints and experience indicators, correlate them with network KPIs to drive service improvements and corrective actions.


**Technical/ Functional Competencies**
* Packet Core KPI Monitoring: Track performance across MME, SGW, PGW, PCRF, and DNS elements.
* Enterprise Core Performance: Monitor DRA, OCS, PCRF, AAA, and APN performance indicators.
* Data Core Protocols: Understand S11, S5, and S8 interfaces, along with GTP, Diameter, and Radius protocols.
* Capacity Utilization Analysis: Analyse IP pool utilization, throughput trends, and demand projections.
* Network Performance Reporting and Alerting: Prepare KPI dashboards, configure threshold alerts, and support performance reporting.
* Cloud Infrastructure Performance: Understand RHOSP and RHOCP architectures and monitor key cloud performance indicators.
* User Experience KPI Correlation: Correlate OpenSignal, TTFB, latency, throughput, packet loss, and discard\-rate metrics with network performance.


**Behavioural \& Leadership Competencies**
* Analytical Thinking: Strong capability to dissect complex network data and troubleshoot underlying protocol issues.
* First\-Time\-Right Approach: High commitment to quality and accuracy in execution to minimize network downtime.
* Accountability \& Ownership: Demonstrated capability to own network issues from initial detection through to final resolution.
* Digital Mindset: Adaptable to evolving cloud\-native telecom technologies and automated monitoring systems.
* Collaboration: Proven track record of working effectively across cross\-functional engineering and infrastructure teams.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
**Minimum Education Qualification**
 B.E./B.Tech — Electronics / Telecommunications / Computer Science.

 Minimum 4–6 years of experience in core network performance management or Packet Core operations, with exposure to multi\-vendor 4G/VoLTE environments and a basic understanding of Cloud/NFV infrastructure.

**Company Description** 
 SQUAREA is a luxury real estate advisory firm headquartered in Kharadi, Pune, with a strong and growing presence in Dubai. The firm provides end\-to\-end advisory services across luxury residential properties, branded residences, Grade‑A commercial real estate, and investment\-led real estate portfolios for clients in India and overseas. Leveraging deep market expertise and global experience, SQUAREA helps investors identify premium apartments in Pune, high\-quality commercial assets, and research\-backed investment opportunities. The team offers strategic, data\-driven guidance tailored to individual client needs, spanning residential, commercial, and branded developments. In Dubai, SQUAREA also enables clients to access top\-tier properties and high\-yield investment options, supporting confident participation in global real estate markets.
   

  

**Role Description** 
 The Commercial Closing Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Pune City, responsible for overseeing the end\-to\-end closing process for commercial real estate transactions. This role coordinates all documentation, compliance checks, and funding activities to ensure accurate and timely closings for Grade‑A commercial assets and other investment\-led deals. The Commercial Closing Manager will collaborate closely with sales teams, lenders, legal advisors, and clients to manage loan and mortgage\-related requirements, resolve issues, and maintain clear communication throughout the transaction lifecycle. Daily responsibilities include preparing and reviewing closing packages, tracking transaction milestones, monitoring disbursements, and maintaining detailed records in line with regulatory and internal standards. The role also contributes to process improvement, supports risk management, and helps deliver a smooth and transparent closing experience for all stakeholders.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong expertise in commercial real estate closings, with practical experience managing Closings and Funding activities.

* Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple transactions simultaneously.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills, including working with clients, legal teams, and financial institutions.
* Prior experience in commercial real estate, banking, or mortgage operations is highly beneficial.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Law, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Comfort with using transaction management software, spreadsheets, and digital documentation tools.
* Ability to work on\-site in East Pune and collaborate in a fast\-paced, performance\-driven environment.

title: Category Manager - Orthopedic Power Systems
description:
Category Manager \- Orthopedic Power Systems
   

 Location: Pune, Maharashtra
   

 Employment Type: Full\-time
   

 Travel: Extensive domestic travel; occasional international travel
   

  

 1\. Role Purpose
   

  

 The Category Manager – Orthopedic Power Systems will be responsible for building, managing, and growing Manman’s Orthopedic Power Systems business as an independent strategic category.
   

  

 The role will own the complete category lifecycle — from market intelligence, product strategy and portfolio planning to pricing, sales enablement, channel development, marketing, product launches, inventory planning and profitability.
   

  

 The individual will act as the central interface between R\&D, Engineering, Production, Quality \& Regulatory, Sales, Service, Marketing, Finance and Supply Chain, ensuring that the Orthopedic Power Systems portfolio remains clinically relevant, commercially competitive and financially successful.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should combine strong orthopedic product knowledge with commercial and business\-development capability.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 2\. Key Responsibilities
   

  

 A. Category Strategy \& Business Ownership
   

  

 \- Develop and execute the annual and long\-term strategy for the Orthopedic Power Systems category.
   

 \- Own category revenue, gross margin, market share and growth objectives.
   

 \- Develop annual business plans covering:
   

 \- Revenue
   

 \- Unit volumes
   

 \- ASP
   

 \- Gross margin
   

 \- Product mix
   

 \- Channel mix
   

 \- Geographic expansion
   

 \- Identify new market opportunities, customer segments and applications for orthopedic power systems.
   

 \- Develop category growth strategies for India and selected international markets.
   

 \- Track competitors, pricing, technology, product launches and market positioning.
   

 \- Identify gaps in Manman’s portfolio and recommend new products or product variants.
   

  

 B. Product Portfolio Management
   

  

 Own the complete Orthopedic Power Systems portfolio, including relevant:
   

  

 \- High\-speed drill systems
   

 \- Large\-bone systems
   

 \- Small\-bone systems
   

 \- Saw systems
   

 \- Oscillating/sagittal saws
   

 \- Reciprocating saws
   

 \- Shaver systems
   

 \- Endoscopic burr systems
   

 \- Attachments
   

 \- Handpieces
   

 \- Accessories
   

 \- Consumables
   

 \- Batteries and chargers
   

 \- Related service and AMC offerings
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Define product positioning and target customer for each product.
   

 \- Maintain the product portfolio and product lifecycle.
   

 \- Identify products requiring upgrades, replacement or discontinuation.
   

 \- Develop product roadmaps in coordination with R\&D and Engineering.
   

 \- Define product specifications based on market and clinical requirements.
   

 \- Gather voice\-of\-customer and surgeon feedback.
   

 \- Convert clinical requirements into clear product requirements for Engineering/R\&D.
   

  

 C. Product Development \& New Product Introduction
   

  

 \- Prepare Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) for new products.
   

 \- Work with Engineering/R\&D on product development priorities.
   

 \- Coordinate prototype evaluation with surgeons and key opinion leaders.
   

 \- Organize clinical/user evaluations and product trials.
   

 \- Coordinate with Quality \& Regulatory for required documentation and approvals.
   

 \- Develop launch plans for new products.
   

 \- Establish product readiness gates before commercial launch.
   

 \- Coordinate first production, field trials and commercial release.
   

  

 D. Pricing \& Commercial Management
   

  

 \- Develop product pricing strategy based on:
   

 \- Manufacturing cost
   

 \- Landed cost
   

 \- Competitor pricing
   

 \- Clinical value
   

 \- Channel margins
   

 \- Customer segment
   

 \- Market positioning
   

 \- Recommend MRP, distributor/dealer pricing and institutional pricing.
   

 \- Monitor discounting and price realization.
   

 \- Develop tender and institutional pricing frameworks.
   

 \- Identify opportunities to improve category gross margin.
   

 \- Monitor profitability by product, customer segment and channel.
   

  

 E. Sales Enablement
   

  

 Work closely with the Sales team to increase conversion and category penetration.
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Develop sales presentations and product literature.
   

 \- Create product comparison sheets.
   

 \- Develop competitive battle cards.
   

 \- Conduct regular product training for sales teams and distributors.
   

 \- Train sales personnel on clinical applications and product positioning.
   

 \- Support major customer meetings, product demonstrations and evaluations.
   

 \- Participate in important tenders and institutional negotiations.
   

 \- Support the sales team in converting strategic accounts.
   

  

 F. Surgeon \& Key Opinion Leader Engagement
   

  

 Build strong relationships with orthopedic surgeons, hospitals and clinical experts.
   

  

 \- Identify and develop Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs).
   

 \- Conduct surgeon feedback programs.
   

 \- Organize product demonstrations and workshops.
   

 \- Coordinate product evaluations at hospitals.
   

 \- Gather structured feedback on product performance and clinical usability.
   

 \- Identify emerging surgical techniques and applications.
   

 \- Develop surgeon advisory panels where appropriate.
   

 \- Convert clinical feedback into product\-development priorities.
   

  

 G. Channel \& Market Development
   

  

 \- Develop strategies for direct, dealer and distributor channels.
   

 \- Identify and onboard suitable channel partners.
   

 \- Define territory\-wise category opportunities.
   

 \- Develop distributor sales targets and business plans.
   

 \- Monitor distributor inventory and secondary sales.
   

 \- Identify underpenetrated states and territories.
   

 \- Support international expansion of the category where required.
   

 \- Develop market\-entry plans for new countries.
   

  

 H. Marketing \& Category Communication
   

  

 Work with the Marketing team to build the Orthopedic Power Systems brand and category.
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Develop category positioning and messaging.
   

 \- Plan product launches and campaigns.
   

 \- Create clinical and technical marketing content.
   

 \- Develop brochures, catalogues, videos and digital content.
   

 \- Support exhibitions, conferences and workshops.
   

 \- Plan surgeon engagement activities.
   

 \- Develop product demonstrations and educational material.
   

 \- Measure marketing effectiveness and lead conversion.
   

  

 I. Demand Planning \& Inventory
   

  

 Work closely with Sales, Production and Supply Chain to ensure the right product availability.
   

  

 \- Prepare monthly and annual demand forecasts.
   

 \- Translate sales plans into SKU\-level forecasts.
   

 \- Monitor inventory levels and ageing.
   

 \- Identify slow\-moving and obsolete inventory.
   

 \- Coordinate production planning based on demand.
   

 \- Ensure availability of critical handpieces, attachments, batteries and consumables.
   

 \- Monitor forecast accuracy.
   

 \- Work towards improving inventory turns and working capital efficiency.
   

  

 J. Service \& Product Lifecycle Management
   

  

 Work closely with the Service team to improve customer experience and product lifecycle economics.
   

  

 \- Analyse field failures and service complaints.
   

 \- Identify recurring product issues.
   

 \- Coordinate corrective actions with Engineering and Quality.
   

 \- Monitor warranty claims.
   

 \- Develop AMC/service opportunities.
   

 \- Identify opportunities for refurbishment, upgrades and replacement sales.
   

 \- Track installed base and replacement cycles.
   

 \- Develop strategies for consumable and accessory attachment.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 3\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

 The Category Manager will be evaluated on measurable business outcomes including:
   

  

 Commercial
   

  

 \- Category revenue growth
   

 \- Unit sales growth
   

 \- Gross margin
   

 \- Average selling price
   

 \- Price realization
   

 \- Product mix
   

 \- New customer acquisition
   

  

 Market
   

  

 \- Market share growth
   

 \- Number of active hospitals
   

 \- Number of active surgeons/users
   

 \- Geographic penetration
   

 \- Dealer/distributor productivity
   

  

 Product
   

  

 \- New product launches
   

 \- Launch success
   

 \- Product adoption
   

 \- Product lifecycle management
   

 \- Customer satisfaction
   

 \- Product quality feedback
   

  

 Channel
   

  

 \- Active distributors/dealers
   

 \- Distributor sales
   

 \- Secondary sales
   

 \- Dealer productivity
   

 \- Channel inventory
   

  

 Operational
   

  

 \- Forecast accuracy
   

 \- Inventory turns
   

 \- Slow\-moving inventory
   

 \- Product availability
   

 \- Warranty/service performance
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 4\. Cross\-Functional Responsibilities
   

  

 The Category Manager will work closely with:
   

  

 Function\| Primary Interaction
   

 Sales\| Revenue, pipeline, product conversion
   

 Marketing\| Category positioning and campaigns
   

 R\&D / Engineering\| Product development and roadmap
   

 Production\| Costing, capacity and product availability
   

 Quality \& Regulatory\| Compliance and product approvals
   

 Service\| Installed base, failures and lifecycle
   

 Supply Chain\| Forecasting and inventory
   

 Finance\| Pricing, margins and profitability
   

 Management\| Category strategy and business reviews
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 5\. Candidate Profile
   

  

 Education
   

  

 Preferred:
   

  

 \- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Life Sciences, Pharmacy or a related discipline.
   

 \- MBA in Marketing, Product Management or Business Management will be an advantage.
   

  

 Experience
   

  

 5–10 years of relevant experience, preferably in:
   

  

 \- Orthopedic medical devices
   

 \- Surgical instruments
   

 \- Orthopedic power tools
   

 \- Neurosurgical power tools
   

 \- Surgical equipment
   

 \- Medical device product management
   

 \- Medical device sales/business development
   

  

 Candidates with strong experience in orthopedic power tools, surgical drills, saws, shavers or related capital equipment will be preferred.
   

  

 Required Skills
   

  

 \- Strong understanding of orthopedic surgical procedures and applications.
   

 \- Product management experience.
   

 \- Commercial and business\-development orientation.
   

 \- Strong analytical and market\-research capabilities.
   

 \- Understanding of medical\-device distribution.
   

 \- Pricing and margin management.
   

 \- Excellent presentation and communication skills.
   

 \- Ability to interact confidently with orthopedic surgeons.
   

 \- Ability to work with engineering and technical teams.
   

 \- Strong negotiation skills.
   

 \- Willingness to travel extensively.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 6\. Desired Personal Attributes
   

  

 The ideal candidate should be:
   

  

 \- Commercially aggressive but analytically driven
   

 \- Customer and surgeon focused
   

 \- Strong in ownership and execution
   

 \- Comfortable working with ambiguity
   

 \- Data driven
   

 \- Curious about technology
   

 \- Strong at cross\-functional coordination
   

 \- Able to understand both clinical and commercial requirements
   

 \- Comfortable presenting to senior management
   

 \- Willing to spend significant time in the field
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 7\. What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Within the first 12 months, the Category Manager should be able to:
   

  

 1\. Establish a clear strategy for the Orthopedic Power Systems category.
   

 2\. Build a comprehensive competitor and market map.
   

 3\. Define the product portfolio and product roadmap.
   

 4\. Establish SKU\-level sales and demand forecasts.
   

 5\. Improve sales\-team product capability.
   

 6\. Build a structured surgeon/KOL engagement program.
   

 7\. Improve product conversion and market penetration.
   

 8\. Identify new product and portfolio opportunities.
   

 9\. Improve category gross margins and price realization.
   

 10\. Establish a measurable category review system with monthly business dashboards.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 8\. Role Philosophy
   

  

 This is not a conventional Product Manager role.
   

  

 The Category Manager is expected to operate as the business owner of Orthopedic Power Systems, with responsibility extending beyond product specifications into revenue, profitability, market development, customer adoption and portfolio growth.
   

  

 The role requires an individual who can move seamlessly between a surgeon discussion in the morning, a product\-development meeting in the afternoon and a commercial/business review with management in the evening.

title: Manager - Infrastructure Control Operator (ICO)
description:

 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

 Northern Trust is looking for an Infrastructure Control Operator (ICO) to play a vital role in supporting and maintaining infrastructure\-related controls throughout the organization. This position is responsible for ensuring adherence to internal risk frameworks, infrastructure standards, and regulatory requirements. Key duties include performing control related activities, monitoring control performance, maintaining comprehensive documentation, and supporting both internal and external audits. The successful candidate will demonstrate consistent achievement of SLA commitments and timely execution of control tasks.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
**Team Leadership \& Oversight**
* Supervise day\-to\-day operations of the Infrastructure Control Operator team.
* Assign tasks, monitor performance, and ensure timely execution of control activities.
* Provide coaching, mentoring, and training to staff to ensure consistent quality and compliance.


**Stakeholder Engagement**
* Act as a liaison between control operations and infrastructure, risk, and compliance teams.
* Facilitate communication and alignment across teams to ensure control objectives are met.


**Control Execution**
* Perform routine Business\-As\-Usual (BAU) control operations.
* Execute all control procedures efficiently and within designated timelines.


**Monitor Performance**
* Evaluate control performance regularly, escalating concerns as appropriate.


**Reporting And Metrics**
* Prepare and deliver pre\-defined periodic reports on control operations, exceptions, and utilization status
* Track and report key performance indicators (KPIs) and key risk indicators (KRIs) relevant to control activities.


**Evidence Readiness**
* Maintain complete and compliant records of all control operational activities, adhering to internal standards and regulatory obligations.
* Organize and provide evidence promptly for audit purposes or stakeholder requests.


**Internal/External Audit Support**
* Facilitate internal and external audits by supplying required documentation and evidence.
* Assist with the preparation, coordination, and follow\-up of audit responses and remedial measures as necessary.


**Collaboration**
* Work collaboratively with stakeholders to ensuring adherence to both internal policies and external regulatory standards.


**Soft Skills**
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.


**Must Haves**
* Proven experience in Infrastructure controls, risk management, or infrastructure support roles, preferably in regulated environments.
* Hands on experience in Control Testing, SOX/SOC audit.
* Review control checklists and playbooks for completeness, accuracy, and effectiveness.
* Ability to clearly document control operations in a structured playbook format, enabling its use as a standardized and repeatable checklist for execution and compliance.
* Understanding of infrastructure platforms and infrastructure standards.
* Hands on experience in operating and tracking controls effectively.
* Strong reporting skills, tracking and maintaining KPIs.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate with different teams effectively.
* Ability to identify reporting anomalies and escalate issues appropriately.
* Practical knowledge of creating Microsoft 365 Copilot agents with clear instructions, defined scope, and appropriate source grounding.
* Ability to apply techniques that reduce Copilot hallucinations, improve response accuracy, and support reliable, audit\-ready outputs.


**Good To Have**
* Service\-Now and Power BI experience as user.
* Highly motivated, energetic self\-starter who takes ownership of issues and drives them to resolution.
* Good organizational skills \- manages and prioritizes multiple tasks across different time horizons within deadlines.
* Strong analytical, problem solving and process re\-engineering skills.
* Experience with control monitoring tools and systems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for reporting, documentation, and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC)
* Familiarity with control frameworks, risk management practices, and compliance regulations (e.g., GDPR, SOX, etc.).


**Required Skills**
 As a partner at Northern Trust, you must actively manage and mitigate risk and act with integrity. In accordance with our core values of service, integrity, and expertise, you are expected to:
   

  

* Adhere to all applicable risk management programs, policies, and procedures.
* Complete all mandatory training by the deadline.
* Understand how your behavior could expose Northern Trust, its clients, and financial markets to different types of risk.
* Ensure that Northern Trust or its clients are not exposed to inappropriate or excessive risk.
* Escalate any risk concerns, including those resulting from mistakes / errors to a manager or business unit risk officer.
* Exercise diligence regarding cyber\-security
* Cooperate with internal control functions (including first\-line Control, Risk, Compliance, Audit, self\-assigned, etc.) and applicable regulatory bodies.


 Avoid conflicts of interest or behaviors that might produce unfair outcomes for Northern Trust or its clients or damage the integrity of financial markets
   

  

**Qualification**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Risk Management, or a related field.

**Working with Us**

Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

title: Assistant General Manager (AGM)- Operations
description:

 Husco provides individuals the opportunity to pursue a career within a fast\-paced, industry leading and entrepreneurial organization. The AGM – Operations will be required to define and coordinate resources (people and equipment) as needed to meet production plan requirements while ensuring the department budget plan is achieved. The AGM – Operations will maintain appropriate staffing and overtime levels to support business needs, and coordinate resources as needed between production departments. Provide needed support and direction to achieve 100% delivery, high inventory turns, machine/tooling optimization, safety and housekeeping. Working closely with cross\-functional internal teams and suppliers. A successful AGM – Operations is a high\-quality communicator and leader, detail oriented, has a strong technical background, and effectively drives project execution.
   

  

 Husco is committed to building an environment for employees to be able:
   

  

* To have the flexibility of their own work and put a personal ‘stamp’ on their output
* Continuously expand and development their professional skills and knowledge
* Create a product for our customers that serves a greater purpose to communities around the world


**PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES**
* Manage Production Operations: Establish manufacturing and quality equipment, processes, and procedures in line with HUSCO expectations which meet or exceed planned operational metrics objectives in first pass yield, productivity, efficiency, customer quality and delivery ppm, and equipment availability achieving an overall OEE goal. Direct and coordinate operations to meet performance objectives related to safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and expense management. Define and manage personnel and equipment resource needs in line with production schedules and forecasts. Own and update equipment capacity analysis. Determine how to leverage resources to grow operations to meet the needs of the organization.
* Manage Day to Day Activities of Staff: Provide direction and coordination regarding staffing needs, including permanent additions and reductions and temporary re\-assignments to support production needs. Own and update human capacity analysis. Ensure production record keeping and reporting is properly maintained for attendance, overtime, performance reviews, accident reporting, disciplinary actions, etc., and is consistently enforced across all areas of responsibility. Direct team to maximize staffing utilization and production output in accordance with operator training standards. Identify and coordinate staff training needs to ensure a flexible workforce to meet our customers’ needs.
* Support New Product Development / Launches: Support the new product development process through participation in PFMEA, DFM, and CAPP activities to ensure project and operational objectives are met.
* Manage Continuous Improvement Efforts: Develop and drive longer term initiatives and projects for continuous and step function improvement in key performance metrics related to safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and profitability.
* Maintain a Lean Manufacturing Culture: Use lean manufacturing techniques coupled with data driven decision making to drive 0 ppm customer reported quality, warranty and on\-time delivery standards.
* Champion for Safety: Create an operation that meets all state regulatory standards for safety. Establish a positive culture aligned with the organization’s mission, HR policies and procedures, and consistent with HUSCO’s core values. Safety focus is critical. Responsible for continuous training/education initiatives with intent to eliminate recordable and /or lost time injuries. Also responsible for housekeeping in accordance with 5S principles.
* Provide Exemplary Internal / External Customer Service \& Communication: Work closely with internal product and manufacturing engineering, and in some cases customers, during program launch to execute requests, respond to questions and build collaboration across teams (both internal and external) as necessary. Will be in regular communications with all levels of internal operations personnal to ensure production schedules are being achieved and prompt responses to all issues and inquiries.
* Strong Team Player and Contributor: Able to work well with colleagues and produce results within a fast\-paced and high\-pressure atmosphere. Combines strong attention to detail with an orientation towards results/execution.
* Support Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality and Sales Functions: As required, support the other roles in the company for successful operation of the overall business. Top management shall assign personnel with responsibility and authority to ensure that customer requirements are met. This includes but is not limited to the selection of special characteristics, setting quality objectives and related training, corrective and preventive actions, product design and development, capacity analysis, logistics information, customer scorecards, and customer portals.
* Develop Employees: Provide a clear strategic direction and vision for direct reports which align with corporate objectives and manufacturing strategies. Demonstrate core cultural competencies to subordinates. Provide challenging and stretching tasks and assignments. Attracts, develops and retains the best people from inside or outside the organization. Improve performance and abilities of subordinates by primarily leading by example and secondarily training, counseling, disciplining and responding to employee ideas and concerns. Bring out the best in people and is an effective people builder.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Manufacturing, or Industrial Engineering (or equivalent)
* A minimum of 15 years of experience in Production Management or production support in a manufacturing environment.
* Strong interpersonal and leadership skills required.
* Union/Union avoidance experience a plus.
* Experience with Microsoft Office products.
* Effective troubleshooting, problem solving and organizational skills. Able to handle frequent interruptions, meet tight deadlines, and handle conflict in an effective manner.
* Ability to interact with people at all levels of responsibility.


**Who We Are:**
 Imagine a place where your career can soar, where innovation meets excellence, and where your contributions truly matter. Welcome to Husco.
   

  

 Here, you’ll find the freedom to shape your work and leave a lasting impact. We believe in empowering you to grow personally and professionally, continuously enhancing your skills and knowledge.
   

  

 Your role at Husco goes beyond the ordinary – you’ll be at the forefront of supporting teams that develop innovative hydraulic and electro\-mechanical systems that enhance efficiency and performance. These products make a real difference globally, building the communities we live in, growing the food that feeds us, and enhancing transportation around the world.

title: Manager - Cloud & Security Customer Service Operations
description:

 Tata Communications Redefines Connectivity with Innovation and IntelligenceDriving the next level of intelligence powered by Cloud, Mobility, Internet of Things, Collaboration, Security, Media services and Network services, we at Tata Communications are envisaging a New World of Communications
   

  

**Broad outline of the Role**
* Responsible for providing L3 operational support for customer network services and solutions delivered across the data centre environment, including Cisco ACI, Nexus switches, routing, switching, and associated network services.
* Responsible for diagnosing and resolving complex network incidents, performing root cause analysis, and providing appropriate technical solutions within agreed service levels.
* Acts as a conduit between customers and internal teams such as Network Engineering, Architecture, Security, Systems, and Operations for effective issue resolution.
* This is an operational role responsible for maintaining the availability, performance, and reliability of data centre network infrastructure, while providing technical guidance to L1/L2 support teams and reviewing the quality of technical work undertaken by these teams.


**Minimum Qualifications \& Experience**
* Graduate with 7–12 years of relevant network engineering experience.
* Strong hands\-on experience in data centre networking.
* Hands\-on experience with Cisco ACI and Cisco Nexus environments.
* Experience working in an L3 network support/engineering role in a 24x7 operational environment.


**Other Knowledge \& Skills**
* Good knowledge of Cisco ACI, Nexus switching, routing and switching, VLAN, VRF, BGP, OSPF, vPC, LACP, TCP/IP, and network troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of ACI concepts such as Spine/Leaf architecture, APIC, EPGs, Bridge Domains, Contracts, and L3Out.
* Experience in troubleshooting complex network connectivity, routing, switching, and data centre infrastructure issues.
* Good understanding of integration with firewalls, load balancers, WAN, servers, and other infrastructure components.
* Good understanding of incident, problem, change, and service management processes.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis skills.

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Provide L3 technical administration, configuration, troubleshooting, and support to ensure efficient functionality and availability of data centre network infrastructure.
* Perform incident validation, incident analysis, root cause analysis, and solution recommendation for complex network and ACI\-related issues.

* Act as a point of escalation for Level\-1 and Level\-2 network support teams, providing technical guidance and assistance in resolving complex incidents.
* Coordinate with Network Engineering, Architecture, Security, Systems, Cloud, Application, and Operations teams on escalations, performance issues, outages, and service\-impacting incidents.
* Coordinate with Cisco TAC and other technology vendors for complex issues requiring vendor\-level investigation and resolution.
* Assist with the development, revision, and maintenance of Standard Operating Procedures, Working Instructions, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles.
* Participate in network upgrades, ACI maintenance, migrations, implementation activities, and infrastructure refresh projects, including pre\- and post\-change validation.

* Prepare and maintain weekly and monthly operational reports covering incidents, network performance, availability, outages, and service\-related activities.

title: Factory Manager- Aluminium Facades
description:
Production Manager – Aluminium Façades
 



**Company:** 
 McCoy Architectural Systems Pvt. Ltd.
 



**Location:** 
 Chakan, Pune
 



**Department:** 
 Aluminium Façades Manufacturing
 



**Reports to:** 
 Plant Head / Factory Manager
 



**Direct reports:** 
 Production Engineers, Supervisors, Operators, Assembly Technicians and Helpers
 



**Functional coordination:** 
 Engineering, PPC, Quality, Procurement, Stores, Maintenance, EHS and Site Installation
 



 This role is tailored for an architectural façade manufacturing environment involving aluminium façade systems, skylights and related building\-envelope products.
 



 Job purpose
 



 To plan, manage and control aluminium façade production so that products are manufactured safely, accurately, economically and according to approved drawings, project schedules and quality requirements.
 



 Key responsibilities
 



 Production planning and execution
 


* Execute production plans issued by PPC.
* Manage cutting, CNC machining, routing, drilling, assembly and packing activities.
* Ensure correct production sequencing for stick, unitised, semi\-unitised, curtain\-wall and cladding systems.
* Allocate manpower, machines, tools and workstations.
* Monitor daily production against planned quantities and project milestones.
* Coordinate production priorities with Engineering, PPC and Project Management.



 Technical and drawing control
 


* Ensure production uses only approved and revision\-controlled drawings.
* Verify profiles, accessories, glass, brackets, fasteners, gaskets and sealants before production.
* Review fabrication drawings, cutting lists, BOMs and assembly instructions.
* Identify design or constructability issues before production starts.
* Coordinate technical clarifications with the Engineering Department.



 Quality control
 


* Ensure correct profile dimensions, cutting accuracy, drilling positions and assembly tolerances.
* Control joint preparation, corner crimping, screw fixing, sealing and gasket installation.
* Ensure correct use of approved sealants, tapes, fasteners and accessories.
* Coordinate first\-piece inspection and in\-process inspection with QA/QC.
* Reduce rejection, leakage risk, scratches, dents, colour mismatch and rework.
* Support mock\-ups, performance testing and customer inspections.



 Manpower and shop\-floor management
 


* Supervise production supervisors and shift teams.
* Maintain skill matrices and arrange operator training.
* Monitor attendance, discipline, overtime and labour productivity.
* Establish standard work instructions for repetitive operations.
* Promote 5S, visual management and continuous improvement.



 Material and inventory control
 


* Coordinate with Stores for timely availability of aluminium profiles and accessories.
* Control material identification, batch traceability and project\-wise segregation.
* Minimise profile wastage and damage during handling.
* Ensure proper protection of finished components before dispatch.
* Report shortages, excess consumption and material discrepancies.



 Equipment and maintenance
 


* Ensure proper operation of saws, CNC machines, routers, drilling machines, crimping machines and assembly tools.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance with the Maintenance Department.
* Report machine breakdowns and production losses promptly.
* Ensure calibration and condition of measuring instruments and jigs.



 Safety and compliance
 


* Enforce PPE, safe material handling and machine\-guarding requirements.
* Ensure safe use of sealants, solvents, adhesives and cutting equipment.
* Conduct toolbox talks and shop\-floor safety inspections.
* Stop unsafe work and report incidents or near misses.
* Maintain good housekeeping and emergency access routes.



 Dispatch and site coordination
 


* Coordinate packing and dispatch in the required installation sequence.
* Ensure identification marks, labels, packing lists and project documents are complete.
* Support site teams with installation feedback and technical clarification.
* Analyse site complaints and implement corrective actions in production.



 Key performance indicators
 


* Production plan achievement
* On\-time project dispatch
* Labour productivity
* First\-pass quality acceptance
* Rework and rejection percentage
* Aluminium profile utilisation and wastage
* Machine utilisation and downtime
* Material damage during production
* Customer/site complaints
* Safety observations and incidents
* 5S and housekeeping audit score



 Decision\-making authority
 



 The Production Manager may:
 


* Allocate manpower and production resources.
* Re\-sequence work within approved project priorities.
* Hold defective or damaged material for inspection.
* Stop production where drawings, materials or safety conditions are inadequate.
* Recommend overtime, subcontracting or additional manpower.
* Initiate corrective action for recurring production problems.



 Changes to design, specifications, material grades, finishes or approved drawings require Engineering and Quality approval.
 



 Qualification
 


* Degree or diploma in Mechanical, Production, Manufacturing or Industrial Engineering.
* Additional knowledge of aluminium façade systems, curtain walls, cladding or glazing is preferred.
* Knowledge of CAD drawings, BOMs, production planning and inspection procedures.



 Experience
 


* 8–12 years in aluminium façade, curtain\-wall, cladding, glazing or architectural metal manufacturing.
* Experience supervising a project\-based, customised production environment.
* Experience with aluminium profiles, CNC machining, façade accessories and assembly tolerances.
* Exposure to site installation and façade mock\-up requirements is desirable.



 Required skills
 


* Aluminium façade production knowledge
* Production planning and manpower control
* Drawing and BOM interpretation
* Problem\-solving and root\-cause analysis
* Quality and dimensional\-control awareness
* ERP/MIS reporting
* Vendor and subcontractor coordination
* Team leadership and communication
* Strong safety and housekeeping discipline



 Personal attributes
 


* Hands\-on shop\-floor leadership
* Strong attention to dimensional and finish quality
* Ability to work under project deadlines
* Practical and systematic problem\-solving approach
* Willingness to work in shifts when required
* High ownership for delivery and customer satisfaction

**Job Description**
**Job Description Summary**
 We are seeking
 ***Manager Database Operations Manager***
 to join our
 ***GTI ( Global Technology Infrastructure)***
 in Global Technology \& Operations.
   

  

**Team/Group Description**
 This position operates in a fast\-paced, innovative, and globally distributed environment with On\-Call responsibilities for critical incidents. If you are a passionate technical leader with deep SQL Server, Oracle and Azure expertise, strong automation capabilities, and a desire to drive excellence within the DBMS Operations group, this role offers an outstanding opportunity to lead enterprise database strategy and deliver transformative business value
   

  

**Role Description**
 The Enterprise Database Operations Lead is a senior technical leadership position responsible for directing the database administration team and ensuring the high availability, security, performance, and scalability of enterprise database platforms across the global organization. This role combines hands\-on expertise in relational database management systems (strong emphasis on Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL in Azure, Oracle and Sybase) with strategic oversight and team management to drive operational excellence, innovation, and alignment with business objectives in a fast\-paced, mission\-critical environment.
   

  

**Applications And Business Or Enterprise Functions The Role Supports**
 Working closely within the Global Technology Infrastructure group, the candidate will collaborate extensively with various support groups, such as Unix and Windows Administration, Storage Management, and global application support teams. This role underpins support for mission\-critical enterprise RDBMS systems, that include financial trading systems, accounting, brokerage, business intelligence and advanced analytics, regulatory compliance and data governance, customer\-facing applications, and disaster recovery/business continuity operations. By maintaining robust, high\-availability database infrastructures, optimizing performance at scale, and enabling seamless data integration, the role minimizes business disruptions, supports real\-time global decision\-making, powers enterprise\-wide reporting and analytics, and enables strategic initiatives such as cloud platform modernization, large\-scale data platform modernization / migrations, and adoption of advanced data services
   

  

**Key Job Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**
* Leading, managing, and mentoring a team of Database Administrators within the DBMS Operations group, including performance evaluations, coaching, resource planning, and fostering a high\-performance, collaborative culture centered on knowledge sharing and continuous technical growth.
* Serving as the organization’s primary subject matter expert on database platforms, diagnosing and resolving complex issues, establishing and enforcing best practices, and ensuring rapid, effective incident response to maintain minimal business impact.
* The candidate will be responsible to manage scalable, resilient database solutions, including advanced high\-availability configurations, disaster recovery strategies, and integration of modern technologies—in close partnership with the broader DBMS Engineering group and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Developing and maintaining sophisticated automation frameworks using advanced scripting (PowerShell, T\-SQL) and tools (SQL Agent \& ControlM scheduler) to streamline critical operations such as backups, patching, monitoring, alerting, capacity management, and routine maintenance.
* Collaborating intensively with application development, infrastructure, and business teams to optimize database design, query and indexing strategies, performance tuning, and application\-database integration while safeguarding data integrity and compatibility.
* Driving proactive performance and tuning, capacity planning, monitoring, and bottleneck resolution using enterprise\-grade tools to deliver optimal system efficiency and reliability.
* Championing knowledge transfer, technical training, and continuous improvement initiatives within the DBMS Operations group; analyzing performance metrics and trends to identify and implement impactful enhancements.
* Providing strategic technical guidance and roadmap input to the enterprise application teams on database platform evolution, including Azure cloud adoption (IaaS/PaaS), platform upgrades/migrations, and evaluation of emerging data technologies to support long\-term organizational objectives.


**What Makes This Role Unique Or Interesting**
 This role combines strong technical leadership with operational responsibility inside the Global Technology infrastructure team, giving you real influence over our enterprise\-scale data infrastructure.
   

  

 You'll gain deep expertise in advanced data server management, large\-scale automation, and modern observability/logging systems — while guiding a talented team through complex, high\-impact challenges.
   

  

 With global scope, mission\-critical systems, and the chance to shape the future of our DBMS strategy, this position bridges hands\-on operations with strategic business impact. It's both highly rewarding and intellectually stimulating.
   

  

**Professional development value of this role**
 Working within Global Technology Infrastructure group this role accelerates growth in advanced technical domains (SQL Server high availability/business intelligence stack, Azure PaaS/IaaS database services, enterprise automation, performance and tuning, Database Virtualization \- such as Delphix) and observability, while significantly strengthening leadership, stakeholder management, and strategic planning capabilities. You will gain experience leading in a sophisticated, global operations environment, handling enterprise\-scale complexity, and driving innovation in cloud and data platform modernization. These experiences position the candidate exceptionally well for future advancement into senior roles such as Senior DBMS Architect, Cloud Data Platform Lead, or broader data/infrastructure leadership positions.
   

  

**Job Qualifications (The Ideal Candidate Should Have The Following)**
 The ideal person will work closely within the DBMS Operations group and should possess:
   

  

* Demonstrated success leading large\-scale, global or multi\-site database environments with strong emphasis on high availability, performance optimization, capacity planning, and mission\-critical system reliability.


**Qualifications, Experience, Education**
 The ideal person will work closely within the DBMS Operations group and should possess:
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
* 8\+ years of progressive, hands\-on experience in database administration and engineering, with at least 3 years in a leadership or team lead role managing database professionals in an enterprise setting.


**Skills**
* Proficiency across RDBMS platforms (Microsoft SQL Server primary; Oracle, PostgreSQL, with some knowledge of Sybase \& IQ, Redis Cache experience beneficial)
* Expert knowledge of SQL Server technologies, including Failover Clustering, AlwaysOn Availability Groups, Log Shipping, SSIS (Integration Services), SSRS (Reporting Services), and SSAS (Analysis Services).
* Advanced programming skills in PowerShell and T\-SQL for sophisticated automation, scripting, and query optimization; familiarity with .NET development is advantageous.
* Strong experience with performance monitoring and management tools (e.g., SCOM, Foglight, or equivalent enterprise solutions). Knowledge in database virtualization techniques such as Delphix
* Deep understanding of Windows Server, Linux and Solaris operating systems.
* Proficiency with Cloud (Azure) technologies, including IaaS and PaaS database offerings, virtual machine sizing, disk and storage management, and related cloud infrastructure components.
* Knowledge of Splunk and other logging/observability technologies for centralized monitoring, alerting, and root\-cause analysis.
* Advanced SQL skills for complex data manipulation, performance tuning, indexing strategies, query plan analysis, and optimization.


**Soft Skills And Other Requirements**
* Exceptional communication skills, with proven ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences (engineers, architects, executives, and non\-technical stakeholders), produce clear documentation, and facilitate productive cross\-team collaboration.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset, rapid adaptability in high\-pressure situations, and the ability to balance independent initiative with effective teamwork.
* Preferred certifications: Microsoft Certified: Microsoft SQL Server\-related certifications, Azure Database Administrator Associate (or equivalent), Oracle Certified Professional (OCP), or relevant Azure/AWS cloud database certifications.

title: Program Governance Manager – Customer Experience
description:
**Job Title: Program Governance Manager – Customer Experience** 




**Location: Pune, India (Hybrid)** 




**Permanent \- Full Time** 




  





**About Us:** 




 Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400\+ employees and 70,000\+ customers across 100\+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end\-to\-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen \& Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass \& Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North \& South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.
 



  





 Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end\-to\-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world\-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.
 



  





 Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specialised in technology.
 



  





**About The Role:** 




 The Program Governance Manager – Customer Experience is a relationship and governance role, not a target\-carrying operations role. You own the mechanism that makes the partnership work: the reporting, cadence, coordination, and health of the relationship. The delivery targets themselves (service levels, quality and cost) sit with the operational leaders. Your job is to make sure the partner always knows what is expected and where they stand, and that Cyncly leaders always have an accurate, current picture of the performance outputs of the BPO. Leaders such as our CX Domain Directors, SVP CX, CCO, and wider executive members.
 



  





 We work with a strategic outsourcing (BPO) partner to deliver customer support across multiple domains, product lines, and regions. This role is the single point of contact between Cyncly and that partner.
 



  





 You will keep a clear, consistent, and trusted view of how the relationship is performing, so that everyone on both sides always knows where things stand. You will stand the partnership up through transition and go\-live and then run the ongoing relationship day to day.
 



  





 The role is designed to expand as trust is earned: at the start, you stand up the mechanism, get reporting flowing, establish the governance cadence and make the transition land cleanly; as the relationship settles, you move from reactive to proactive by anticipating risks, championing change and building a genuine joint team; and in the mature relationship, you become a true partnership steward, keeping leadership sponsorship sharp and the relationship healthy and honest. The through\-line is a move from running the reporting to making the partnership succeed.
 



  





**Main Responsibilities:** 



* Act as the single point of contact for Cyncly's outsourcing partner across operational, reporting and relationship matters.
* Build and run the governance rhythm, including performance reporting, review meetings, quarterly business reviews, agendas, minutes, and action tracking.
* Produce clear, accurate performance reporting and maintain one consistent view of how the partnership is performing, creating a single trusted version rather than different stories across the business.
* Route and coordinate escalations to the right owners and drive them through to resolution.
* Coordinate capacity, workforce planning, and forecasting between partner and internal teams.
* Track risks, actions, issues and decisions, and surface emerging risks early.
* Lead Cyncly's side of the transition and go\-live, partnering closely with the provider's transition team, then carrying the relationship into a steady state.
* Champion continuous improvement and a genuine one\-team relationship built on trust and honest communication rather than adversarial vendor management.



  





**Required Skills and Experience:** 




**Experience** 



* Typically 8 to 14 years of experience in customer experience, contact center or BPO delivery, including experience managing or governing an outsourced engagement from the client side.
* Equivalent experience is valued; formal project, programme or partnership\-management credentials are welcomed where they support the role, but are not the primary requirement.
* Strong governance, project and relationship\-management discipline across cadence, reporting, risk tracking and stakeholder communication.
* Credibility and presence to hold governance with senior stakeholders on both sides, and to represent the business well.
* Solid grounding in contact\-centre operations, including workforce management, forecasting, customer satisfaction and quality, so you can coordinate meaningfully and interrogate the numbers.
* Comfort working with delivery data and reporting tools, and manipulating such data to be presented in a variety of formats to varying stakeholders of varying seniority
* Experience with Zendesk or a comparable ITSM/CCaaS customer service platform(s).
* Ability to create trust, maintain clarity, and build a one\-team relationship with an outsourcing partner while keeping accountability clear.
* Experience working in global teams \& managing stakeholders across geographies.



  





**Preferred but not required** 



* Experience standing up or transitioning outsourced engagement, with exposure to commercial negotiations and management.
* A project or programme management background, for example PMP certification.
* Experience across multiple regions and product areas.



  





**Working For Us:** 




 At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills \- and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.
 



  





 Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.
 



  





 We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone \- from every background \- to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.
 



  





 If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in \- come join us.

 Here, you’ll work alongside a team of relentless problem\-solvers who are committed to making a tangible impact. If you’re ready to break boundaries, deliver results, and enjoy the ride along the way, you’ll thrive here.
   

  

**About The Role**
 To ensure maximum equipment availability, reliability, and efficiency of manufacturing operations through effective preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance. The role is responsible for maintaining plant machinery, utilities, and infrastructure while driving continuous improvement, cost optimization, and safety compliance in an automotive manufacturing environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Plant \& Equipment Maintenance
* Plan, execute, and monitor preventive and predictive maintenance activities.
* Ensure minimum machine downtime and maximum equipment uptime.
* Lead breakdown analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Monitor machine health and reliability parameters.
* Production Support
* Ensure continuous support to production for uninterrupted manufacturing.
* Coordinate with Production, Quality, and Engineering teams for maintenance planning.
* Attend critical machine breakdowns and ensure quick restoration.
* Utility Management
* Manage plant utilities such as Compressors, DG Sets, HVAC, Cooling Systems, Transformers, Electrical Panels, and Water Systems.
* Ensure uninterrupted utility supply to manufacturing operations.
* Monitor utility consumption and identify energy\-saving opportunities.
* TPM \& Continuous Improvement
* Drive TPM (Total Productive Maintenance) initiatives.
* Implement Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing, and productivity improvement projects.
* Improve MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures) and reduce MTTR (Mean Time To Repair).
* Lead cost reduction and operational excellence initiatives.
* Maintenance Planning \& Budget Control
* Prepare annual maintenance plans and shutdown schedules.
* Manage maintenance budgets and control repair costs.
* Ensure optimum inventory levels of spare parts and consumables.
* Coordinate with vendors for AMC and specialized maintenance activities.
* Team Management
* Lead maintenance engineers, technicians, and contractor manpower.
* Plan manpower deployment across shifts.
* Conduct skill development and technical training programs.
* Monitor team performance and ensure adherence to maintenance standards.
* Safety, Compliance \& Audits
* Ensure compliance with EHS guidelines and statutory requirements.
* Conduct safety inspections and risk assessments.
* Support ISO 9001, IATF 16949, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 audits.
* Ensure compliance with electrical and maintenance safety standards.
* Automation \& Industry 4\.0
* Support automation projects and machine upgrades.
* Monitor PLC, SCADA, Robotics, and automated manufacturing systems.
* Implement predictive maintenance tools and digital monitoring systems.


**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
* Machine Uptime (%)
* Breakdown Frequency
* MTBF Improvement
* MTTR Reduction
* Preventive Maintenance Compliance (%)
* Maintenance Cost Control
* OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness)
* Energy Consumption Reduction
* Safety Compliance Score
* Spare Parts Inventory Accuracy


**Educational Qualification**
* B.E./B.Tech. in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, Automobile, or Industrial Engineering.
* Diploma holders with strong maintenance experience may also be considered.
* TPM/Lean/Six Sigma certifications preferred.


**Experience**
* 8 to 12 years of experience in Maintenance function within Automotive Manufacturing.
* Experience in handling CNC machines, Assembly Lines, Welding Lines, Paint Shop, Press Shop, or Machining operations.
* Exposure to preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance.
* Hands\-on experience with PLC, Pneumatics, Hydraulics, and Electrical Systems.


**Technical Competencies**
* Preventive \& Predictive Maintenance
* TPM Implementation
* PLC Troubleshooting
* Electrical \& Mechanical Maintenance
* Hydraulics \& Pneumatics
* Utility Management
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
* SAP PM Module / ERP Systems
* OEE Improvement
* Energy Management


**Behavioral Competencies**
* Leadership \& Team Management
* Problem Solving \& Decision Making
* Analytical Thinking
* Planning \& Organizing
* Cross\-functional Coordination
* Communication Skills
* Result Orientation
